Residual ATP is an inverse kinase-activity proxy under added substrate/cofactors, not direct membrane PIP2 concentration. GTPgammaS is not selective for Arf6. Results give 0.012% DMSO whereas Methods give 0.01%; exact solvent concentration needs resolution.

Genetic comparisons and supplementation constrain interpretation but do not identify a unique PIP2-mediated route or exclude effects in other neurovascular cells.

For pharmacological protection, bath diC16-PIP2 is present before recording; it is not a sequential rescue of the same cell after current loss. Repeated ramps and cells nested within mice do not provide independent animal replications.

NAV or vehicle is superfused for twenty minutes; genetic PIP2 flow rescue is a separate cohort from the barium comparison, not a repeated rescue in the same animals.

Technical trial counts also need reconciliation with the Methods average of three trials. Nonsignificance between treated genotypes is not equivalence; no complete physiological rescue or clinical efficacy is established.

Main Figures 1-4 and Methods support scoped reported outcomes, not independent reproduction of data, exclusions, nesting or statistics. Supplemental genotype, blood-pressure, glucose and lower-dose controls are not independently admitted.
